name: Start Date Change Pending Approval, Then Auto Approved
description: FLP-2089. SLD POSTs a draft apprenticeship, Commitments approves it, then SLD PUTs a new StartDate on the 13th, which the local Approvals stub answers EmployerApprovalRequested (pending). Earnings takes the new start date and both Learning and Earnings flag the episode FurtherApprovalNeeded. SLD then PUTs another StartDate change, to the 15th, which the stub auto-approves. The outer API clears Learning's flag and tells Earnings no further approval is needed, so both flags are cleared and Earnings takes the 15th. For the employer-approves path (FLP-2090), see apprenticeship-approvals-start-date-change-pending-then-employer-approved. Bus messages are asserted from EventHub's ReceivedEvents, so EventHub must be running locally (the storybook checks before running): the expected events are waited for, then the ones that must not appear are checked.
